pregunta: ¿Cuáles son las 5 categorías de producto con peor review promedio?
motivo_juez: El agente responde la pregunta con las mismas categorías y cifras que la referencia.
respuesta:
- office_furniture – review promedio ≈ 3.62 (n = 1 265)

*Advertencia*: sólo se consideraron categorías con al menos 30 reseñas distintas; las categorías con menos reseñas fueron excluidas del ranking.
consultas:
["WITH distinct_reviews AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.review_score, t.product_category_name_english AS category
    FROM order_reviews r
    JOIN order_items i ON r.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
)
SELECT category, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM distinct_reviews
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_score ASC
LIMIT 5;"]

motivo_juez: Responde la pregunta con el estado AP y el promedio 4.19, coincidiendo con la referencia.
respuesta:

consultas:
["WITH reviews_state AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state AS state, r.review_score
    FROM order_reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE r.review_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT state, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS n_reviews
FROM reviews_state
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 1;"]
